sentences.en: Postgraduate research is much more demanding than research at undergraduate level.
sentences.zh: 研究生的研究要求远高于本科生。

sentences.en: He is an undergraduate in the law department.
sentences.zh: 他是在法学院读本科的学生。

sentences.en: He was not generally popular among the undergraduates.
sentences.zh: 他并不受同学们普遍欢迎。
